links.outcome: Correctness and comprehensiveness of ChatGPT answers to vitreoretinal clinical scenarios
links.effect: Answered 83% (33/40) correctly but comprehensive in only 52.5% (21/40); six incorrect responses, three with possible harm and two with definitive harm.
links.quote: In June 2023, ChatGPT answered 83% of clinical scenarios (33/40) correctly but provided a comprehensive answer in only 52.5% of cases (21/40).

links.outcome: Frequency of hallucinated references in ChatGPT responses
links.effect: Study assessed the types of sources ChatGPT used and whether references were hallucinated; the abstract gives no hallucination rate.
links.quote: To assess the types of sources ChatGPT primarily uses and to determine whether they are hallucinated.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and potential harm of ChatGPT responses to simulated vitreoretinal clinical scenarios without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
